messages:
Mike H: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Mike H: Did: ran a micro-batch latency sweep on kernel v0.11 (bench harness on staging). p50 ~9.2ms, p95 ~42ms for 512-token seq on the t4-small shim.
Mike H: Blocker: seeing KV cache thrash when slot-steal crosses shard boundary (latency spikes + increased OOMs in one host). Repro steps in thread.
Mike H: Today: try increasing prefetch_window from 32->64 and land a tiny guard in the batcher to avoid merging slots during shard handoff. Also opening a PR for canary patch. Ping @Tara P for quick review.
Tara P: Ack — send the bench command + link to PR and I'll take a look tonight. Do we have perf logs? :mag:
Mike H: bench command: ```./tools/bench_driver --model gpt-like --seq 512 --microbatch 8 --concurrency 16 --kernel v0.11 --collect p50,p95,p99```
Mike H: logs (snip): ```[2026-03-17T20:11:02Z] host-3 p95 spike 42000us, evict_count++ -> 78, slot_steal=1 -> host-4```
Tara P: OK saw that pattern before. Might be related to eviction_threshold being too low on host-3. Can you drop the full diff of the patch?
Mike H: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842 — tiny check in: guard around slot merge + metric emitted for cross_shard_steal.
Tara P: reading now. If tests pass, we should canary to 10% and watch p95s + error-rate.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for kernel v0.11 -> canary group c-17 (3 hosts) at 2026-03-17T21:03:00Z
Anya K: I can own monitoring on the canary. I'll add a dashboard with cross_shard_steal, eviction_count and p95 by host.
Liam S: I can take the KV eviction threshold tuning task tomorrow morning — will try bumping threshold from 0.2 -> 0.35 and run a short soak.
Omar R: FYI, I noticed a related flake in CI: test_integration::cache_recovery occasionally times out after we hit the thrash pattern. Filed issue #1031.
Mike H: Thanks all. No blocker for landing PR once Tara gives thumbs. Will schedule canary watchboard and update incident channel if we see regressions.
Tara P: Quick nits left on PR, nothing blocking. Left review comments. :thumbsup:
Mike H: Sweet — will address and trigger canary->gradual if green.
Liam S: If canary shows improvement, also let's run the 24h throughput job to validate cost delta from prefetch change.
Anya K: Added alert: when cross_shard_steal > 5 within 5m for a host -> page eng-runtime oncall.
Mike H: Awesome. Thanks team — will post follow-up in morning with updated bench runs.
